B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add a full denominator unit after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of matching denominators with an existing fraction denominator.

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solution explicitly rewrites a mixed number as separate whole and fractional parts for setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing 1 from the whole part during subtraction; that is S04.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted directly and the fractional result is nonnegative.
Tag when the solution computes direct subtraction after any needed setup such as normalization or common-denominator conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag cases where the fractional part goes negative and the solver must borrow; include S04 for the regrouping step.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution shows a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted to d/d or an equivalent full-denominator fraction and added to the minuend's fractional part.
Tag for both same-denominator and unlike-denominator mixed or whole-number subtraction after setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that is S02.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction; that is S01.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including recognizing when a zero fractional part yields a whole number or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number is rewritten in lowest terms after combining.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-term result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is also performed in that step.
Do not tag normalization before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items if unlike fractional denominators are aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators are already matched.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator alignment.

skills.name: Normalize whole or mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with standard whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to enable part-by-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combination of final whole and fraction parts into an answer.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion unless the step also rewrites a whole or improper mixed number.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including direct same-denominator fraction subtraction inside pure-fraction or mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same or have been made the same.
Tag when the result may be zero, proper, or improper before any later simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding the common denominator itself.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag borrowing steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts after a negative fractional result.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the two quantities when solving mixed-number or whole-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when whole-part subtraction is done alongside fraction-part subtraction in the same step.
Tag for mixed-minus-whole, whole-minus-mixed, and mixed-minus-mixed items.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction items with no whole-number components.
Do not tag borrowing adjustments such as reducing the whole part by 1 after a negative fraction result.
Do not tag final combination steps that merely state the completed mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full denominator-sized fraction and use it to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted to n/n and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used in whole-minus-fraction, mixed-minus-fraction, or mixed-minus-mixed subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary whole-part subtraction before any regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number done before subtraction begins.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction or mixed number.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer as a fraction, mixed number, or integer as appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final accepted form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet simplified or finalized the result.
Do not tag denominator alignment or borrowing steps.
Do not tag normalization rewrites at the start of the problem.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts require denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when the only rewrite is adding a zero fractional part to a whole number, without changing denominator relationships.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with valid whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite prepares the numbers for separate whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion between proper or improper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that is a later regrouping step.
Do not tag simple combination of final whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they are already expressed with the same denominator, including cases where the result is zero or needs later simplification.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already aligned.
Tag for same-denominator fraction subtraction and for subtraction after an LCD conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating the common denominator itself.
Do not tag whole-number subtraction done separately from fraction subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps where a whole is converted into fractional units before the actual subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components when working with mixed numbers or whole numbers in a decomposed form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly computes the difference of whole parts, such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is handled as the whole-part component of a mixed-number subtraction.
Tag even if the whole-part result is later adjusted by borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction items with no whole-part computation.
Do not tag the later borrowing adjustment itself; that belongs to regrouping.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator, such as 3/3, 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag when the whole-part result is reduced by 1 and the fractional subtraction is recomputed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag if no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag ordinary same-denominator fraction subtraction that does not involve converting a whole into fractional units.

skills.name: Simplify or format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and express the final answer appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when the final whole and fractional parts are combined into a mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that do not simplify or present the final form.
Do not tag denominator matching or borrowing steps.
Do not tag whole-part subtraction by itself.
